office.en: California Insurance Commissioner, November 3, 2026 general election. Democratic. Certified candidate list, August 27, 2026.

sourceTitle.en: California Secretary of State, Official Voter Information Guide for the November 3, 2026 General Election, certified August 10, 2026

spectrumNote.en: Democrat, more cautious about a new public insurance program

summary.en: In the official voter guide he says he would not create an untested large-scale public system that puts taxpayers on the hook. He wants more insurance options and lower rates. That statement is not tied to the health-care question.

whyIncluded.en: The other insurance-commissioner candidate. His voter-guide statement rejects a large new public system and prefers more private options. It is the contrast with Kim, and it is not scored as a health-care position.
